newsitem.title: THAILAND: Somprasong fails to meet ECD deadline.
newsitem.headline: Somprasong fails to meet ECD deadline.

text.p: Thai developer Somprasong Land Plc failed to make a $3.1 million interest payment on its Euroconvertible debenture (ECD) by the February 4 deadline, the company's financial advisers said on Wednesday.
"The company has advised the trustee in London that due to cashflow constraints caused by conditions in the Thai property market, the company has been unable to make payment," the adviser said.
"An audited list of the company's liabilities will be presented by March 7, and on March 21 there will be an independent assessment of assets," he said.
Discussions with bond holders and other company creditors are scheduled to begin shortly after, he said.
Somprasong, which floated an $80 million Euroconvertible debenture in January 1994, became the first Thai company to default on an ECD payment.
